concepts.title: Euler Paths and Circuits
concepts.summary: The Königsberg bridges, the degree condition for Euler paths and circuits with its proof, and Hierholzer's algorithm for finding one.

concepts.title: Hamiltonian Paths and Why They Are Hard
concepts.summary: Hamiltonian paths and cycles, why no simple degree test exists as it does for Euler, sufficient conditions such as Dirac's theorem, and the link to NP-completeness and the traveling salesman problem.

concepts.title: Graph Connectivity: Cut Vertices and Bridges
concepts.summary: Connected components, cut vertices and bridges, vertex and edge connectivity, and how a depth-first search finds them.

concepts.title: Graph Coloring and the Chromatic Number
concepts.summary: Proper colorings, the chromatic number and its bounds, greedy coloring, the four color theorem for planar graphs, and why computing the chromatic number is hard.
